Hello everyone! Im so very excited to start releasing a project that i have long been wanting to do! Bog's Fantasy Portraits! A whole retexture of portraits and sprites in a fantasy theme. Starting with Caroline! She is now a green elf which i think fits her perfectly! I will be releasing these one at a time as im still learning what my new baseline is so hopfully you wont have to wait so long between my mod releases again.

Next up will be Marnie, then Maru! Once i complete all the fems first they will be grouped into a "Bog's Fantasy Fems"﻿ mod. 

Enjoyyy!
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pV5LgMqn/retro-bookcase-7.png[/img]

[/url]The frogs are a commission from my Kofi for Frog Sprinklers
The bat is a replacement for the Fairy Trinket that was a commission as well!
